item.title: Towada-Hachimantai National Park: Akita's Volcanic Highland — Guide
item.description: The Hachimantai plateau in northern Akita is a volcanic highland of crater lakes, alpine marshes and steaming vents. The Aspite Line mountain road (open May–November) traverses the plateau past five-colour marshes and the Hachimantai summit — one of Japan’s great scenic drives, turning incandescent gold and crimson in mid-October. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Kazuno (Hachimantai), Akita Hours Aspite Line ~May–Nov, daytime Admission Free Time needed Half day Best time Mid-Oct (autumn); summer alpine What to See The scenic Aspite Line drive across the plateau.
